plan.title: Increase Event Time with Fixed Time

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as the buyer.
Open the RFQ Responses tab specified by the case.
Open Increase Event Time, choose Fixed time, set it to 30 minutes after the current end, press Ok, and verify Procol saves the extension.
